passages.text: Now Moses’ father-in-law Jethro, the priest of Midian, heard about all that God had done for Moses and His people Israel, and how the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt.
passages.sermon:
Jethro was the priest of Midian.
Jethro was Moses’ father-in-law.
Jethro heard about everything God had done for Moses.
Jethro heard about everything God had done for Israel, God’s people.
The LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt.
Jethro heard about this.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֞ע יִתְר֨וֹ כֹהֵ֤ן מִדְיָן֙ חֹתֵ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֵת֩ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ לְמֹשֶׁ֔ה וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַמּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־ הוֹצִ֧יא יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: After Moses had sent back his wife Zipporah, his father-in-law Jethro had received her, along with her two sons. One son was named Gershom, for Moses had said, “I have been a foreigner in a foreign land.”
passages.sermon:
Moses was a leader of Israel.
Moses had a wife named Zipporah.
Moses had two sons.
Jethro was Moses’ father-in-law.
Jethro was the priest of Midian.
Moses sent his wife Zipporah away.
Jethro received Zipporah after Moses sent her away.
Jethro also received Moses’ two sons.
One son was named Gershom.
Moses named him Gershom because he said, “I have been a foreigner in a foreign land.”
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֗ח יִתְרוֹ֙ חֹתֵ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת־ צִפֹּרָ֖ה אֵ֣שֶׁת מֹשֶׁ֑ה אַחַ֖ר שִׁלּוּחֶֽיהָ׃ וְאֵ֖ת שְׁנֵ֣י בָנֶ֑יהָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר שֵׁ֤ם הָֽאֶחָד֙ גֵּֽרְשֹׁ֔ם כִּ֣י אָמַ֔ר גֵּ֣ר הָיִ֔יתִי בְּאֶ֖רֶץ נָכְרִיָּֽה׃

passages.text: The other son was named Eliezer, for Moses had said, “The God of my father was my helper and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh.”
passages.sermon:
Moses had two sons.
The name of the other son was Eliezer.
Moses gave him this name for a reason.
Moses said, “The God of my father helped me.”
Moses also said, “God saved me from the sword of Pharaoh.”
passages.original: וְשֵׁ֥ם הָאֶחָ֖ד אֱלִיעֶ֑זֶר כִּֽי־ אֱלֹהֵ֤י אָבִי֙ בְּעֶזְרִ֔י וַיַּצִּלֵ֖נִי מֵחֶ֥רֶב פַּרְעֹֽה׃

passages.text: Moses’ father-in-law Jethro, along with Moses’ wife and sons, came to him in the desert, where he was encamped at the mountain of God.
passages.sermon:
Moses was in the desert.
He was camped at the mountain of God.
Jethro was Moses’ father-in-law.
Jethro came to Moses.
Jethro brought Moses’ wife.
Jethro brought Moses’ sons.
They all came to Moses at the mountain of God.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֞א יִתְר֨וֹ חֹתֵ֥ן מֹשֶׁ֛ה וּבָנָ֥יו וְאִשְׁתּ֖וֹ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה אֶל־ הַמִּדְבָּ֗ר אֲשֶׁר־ ה֛וּא חֹנֶ֥ה שָׁ֖ם הַ֥ר הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: He sent word to Moses, “I, your father-in-law Jethro, am coming to you with your wife and her two sons.”
passages.sermon:
Jethro was Moses’ father-in-law.
Jethro sent a message to Moses.
Jethro said, “I am coming to you.”
Jethro said, “Your wife is coming with me.”
Jethro said, “Her two sons are coming with her.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֲנִ֛י חֹתֶנְךָ֥ יִתְר֖וֹ בָּ֣א אֵלֶ֑יךָ וְאִ֨שְׁתְּךָ֔ וּשְׁנֵ֥י בָנֶ֖יהָ עִמָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: So Moses went out to meet his father-in-law and bowed down and kissed him. They greeted each other and went into the tent.
passages.sermon:
Moses was a leader of Israel.
Jethro was Moses’ father-in-law.
Moses went out to meet Jethro.
Moses bowed down to Jethro.
Moses kissed Jethro.
Moses and Jethro greeted each other.
Moses and Jethro went into the tent.
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵ֨א מֹשֶׁ֜ה לִקְרַ֣את חֹֽתְנ֗וֹ וַיִּשְׁתַּ֙חוּ֙ וַיִּשַּׁק־ ל֔וֹ וַיִּשְׁאֲל֥וּ אִישׁ־ לְרֵעֵ֖הוּ לְשָׁל֑וֹם וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ הָאֹֽהֱלָה׃

passages.text: Then Moses recounted to his father-in-law all that the LORD had done to Pharaoh and the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, all the hardships they had encountered along the way, and how the LORD had delivered them.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Jethro was Moses’ father-in-law.
Moses spoke to Jethro.
Moses told Jethro everything the LORD had done.
The LORD had acted against Pharaoh.
The LORD had acted against the Egyptians.
The LORD did these things for Israel’s sake.
Moses described all the hardships Israel faced on the journey.
The LORD delivered Israel from these hardships.
passages.original: וַיְסַפֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ לְחֹ֣תְנ֔וֹ אֵת֩ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לְפַרְעֹ֣ה וּלְמִצְרַ֔יִם עַ֖ל אוֹדֹ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֵ֤ת כָּל־ הַתְּלָאָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מְצָאָ֣תַם בַּדֶּ֔רֶךְ וַיַּצִּלֵ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And Jethro rejoiced over all the good things the LORD had done for Israel, whom He had rescued from the hand of the Egyptians.
passages.sermon:
Jethro was Moses’ father-in-law.
Jethro heard what the LORD had done for Israel.
The LORD had done many good things for Israel.
The LORD had rescued Israel from the Egyptians.
Jethro rejoiced because of all these good things.
passages.original: וַיִּ֣חַדְּ יִתְר֔וֹ עַ֚ל כָּל־ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִצִּיל֖וֹ מִיַּ֥ד מִצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Jethro declared, “Blessed be the LORD, who has delivered you from the hand of the Egyptians and of Pharaoh, and who has delivered the people from the hand of the Egyptians.
passages.sermon:
Jethro was Moses’ father-in-law.
Jethro spoke to Moses and the people.
Jethro said, “Blessed be the LORD.”
The LORD delivered you from the hand of the Egyptians.
The LORD delivered you from the hand of Pharaoh.
The LORD delivered the people from the power of the Egyptians.
passages.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֮ יִתְרוֹ֒ בָּר֣וּךְ יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִצִּ֥יל אֶתְכֶ֛ם מִיַּ֥ד מִצְרַ֖יִם וּמִיַּ֣ד פַּרְעֹ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִצִּיל֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם מִתַּ֖חַת יַד־ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all other gods, for He did this when they treated Israel with arrogance.”
passages.sermon:
Jethro was Moses’ father-in-law.
Jethro spoke about the LORD.
Jethro said, “Now I know something.”
The LORD is greater than all other gods.
The LORD showed His greatness by what He did.
The Egyptians acted arrogantly against Israel.
The LORD acted when they did this.
The LORD proved He is greater than all other gods.
passages.original: עַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּֽי־ גָד֥וֹל יְהוָ֖ה מִכָּל־ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֣י בַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר זָד֖וּ עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Then Moses’ father-in-law Jethro brought a burnt offering and sacrifices to God, and Aaron came with all the elders of Israel to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law in the presence of God.
passages.sermon:
Jethro was Moses’ father-in-law.
Jethro brought a burnt offering to God.
Jethro also brought sacrifices to God.
Aaron came to Jethro.
All the elders of Israel came with Aaron.
They ate bread with Jethro.
They ate in the presence of God.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֞ח יִתְר֨וֹ חֹתֵ֥ן מֹשֶׁ֛ה עֹלָ֥ה וּזְבָחִ֖ים לֵֽאלֹהִ֑ים וַיָּבֹ֨א אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְכֹ֣ל׀ זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לֶאֱכָל־ לֶ֛חֶם עִם־ חֹתֵ֥ן מֹשֶׁ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: The next day Moses took his seat to judge the people, and they stood around him from morning until evening.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
The next day, Moses sat down.
He sat to judge the people.
The people stood around Moses.
They stood from morning until evening.
passages.original: וַיְהִי֙ מִֽמָּחֳרָ֔ת וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב מֹשֶׁ֖ה לִשְׁפֹּ֣ט אֶת־ הָעָ֑ם וַיַּעֲמֹ֤ד הָעָם֙ עַל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה מִן־ הַבֹּ֖קֶר עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: When his father-in-law saw all that Moses was doing for the people, he asked, “What is this that you are doing for the people? Why do you sit alone as judge, with all the people standing around you from morning till evening?”
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Jethro was Moses’ father-in-law.
Jethro saw everything Moses was doing for the people.
Jethro spoke to Moses.
Jethro asked, “What is this that you are doing for the people?”
Jethro asked, “Why do you sit alone?”
Jethro said, “All the people stand around you from morning until evening.”
passages.original: וַיַּרְא֙ חֹתֵ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ ה֥וּא עֹשֶׂ֖ה לָעָ֑ם וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מָֽה־ הַדָּבָ֤ר הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתָּ֤ה עֹשֶׂה֙ לָעָ֔ם מַדּ֗וּעַ אַתָּ֤ה יוֹשֵׁב֙ לְבַדֶּ֔ךָ וְכָל־ הָעָ֛ם נִצָּ֥ב עָלֶ֖יךָ מִן־ בֹּ֥קֶר עַד־ עָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: “Because the people come to me to inquire of God,” Moses replied.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the people.
Moses spoke to his father-in-law.
Moses said, “The people come to me.”
They come to ask about God.
They want to know God’s will.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה לְחֹתְנ֑וֹ כִּֽי־ יָבֹ֥א אֵלַ֛י הָעָ֖ם לִדְרֹ֥שׁ אֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: “Whenever they have a dispute, it is brought to me to judge between one man and another, and I make known to them the statutes and laws of God.”
passages.sermon:
Moses led the people of Israel.
The people sometimes had disputes.
When they had a dispute, they came to Moses.
Moses judged between one man and another.
Moses decided who was right and who was wrong.
Moses explained God’s statutes to the people.
Moses taught them God’s laws.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ יִהְיֶ֨ה לָהֶ֤ם דָּבָר֙ בָּ֣א אֵלַ֔י וְשָׁ֣פַטְתִּ֔י בֵּ֥ין אִ֖ישׁ וּבֵ֣ין רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְהוֹדַעְתִּ֛י אֶת־ חֻקֵּ֥י הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים וְאֶת־ תּוֹרֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: But Moses’ father-in-law said to him, “What you are doing is not good.
passages.sermon: Moses had a father-in-law named Jethro.\r\nJethro spoke directly to Moses.\r\nJethro said, “What you are doing is not good.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֛אמֶר חֹתֵ֥ן מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֵלָ֑יו לֹא־ טוֹב֙ הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֖ה עֹשֶֽׂה׃

passages.text: Surely you and these people with you will wear yourselves out, because the task is too heavy for you. You cannot handle it alone.
passages.sermon:
Moses was leading the people of Israel.
Moses judged every dispute among the people.
Moses’ father-in-law spoke to him.
He said, “You will wear yourself out.”
He said, “The people with you will also wear themselves out.”
He said, “The task is too heavy for you.”
He said, “You cannot do it alone.”
passages.original: נָבֹ֣ל תִּבֹּ֔ל גַּם־ אַתָּ֕ה גַּם־ הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִמָּ֑ךְ כִּֽי־ כָבֵ֤ד מִמְּךָ֙ הַדָּבָ֔ר לֹא־ תוּכַ֥ל עֲשֹׂ֖הוּ לְבַדֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: Now listen to me; I will give you some advice, and may God be with you. You must be the people’s representative before God and bring their causes to Him.
passages.sermon:
Moses’ father-in-law spoke to Moses.
He said, “Listen to me now.
I will give you advice.
May God be with you.
You must stand for the people before God.
You must bring their matters to God.”
passages.original: עַתָּ֞ה שְׁמַ֤ע בְּקֹלִי֙ אִיעָ֣צְךָ֔ וִיהִ֥י אֱלֹהִ֖ים עִמָּ֑ךְ הֱיֵ֧ה אַתָּ֣ה לָעָ֗ם מ֚וּל הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וְהֵבֵאתָ֥ אַתָּ֛ה אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים אֶל־ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: Teach them the statutes and laws, and show them the way to live and the work they must do.
passages.sermon:
Moses, you must teach the people.
You must warn them about the statutes.
You must warn them about the laws.
You must show them the way they should walk.
You must show them the actions they must do.
passages.original: וְהִזְהַרְתָּ֣ה אֶתְהֶ֔ם אֶת־ הַחֻקִּ֖ים וְאֶת־ הַתּוֹרֹ֑ת וְהוֹדַעְתָּ֣ לָהֶ֗ם אֶת־ הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ יֵ֣לְכוּ בָ֔הּ וְאֶת־ הַֽמַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲשֽׂוּן׃

passages.text: Furthermore, select capable men from among the people—God-fearing, trustworthy men who are averse to dishonest gain. Appoint them over the people as leaders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens.
passages.sermon:
You must choose men from among all the people.
These men must be capable.
They must fear God.
They must be trustworthy.
They must hate dishonest gain.
Appoint these men as leaders over the people.
Some will lead thousands.
Some will lead hundreds.
Some will lead fifties.
Some will lead tens.
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה תֶחֱזֶ֣ה מִכָּל־ הָ֠עָם אַנְשֵׁי־ חַ֜יִל יִרְאֵ֧י אֱלֹהִ֛ים אַנְשֵׁ֥י אֱמֶ֖ת שֹׂ֣נְאֵי בָ֑צַע וְשַׂמְתָּ֣ עֲלֵהֶ֗ם שָׂרֵ֤י אֲלָפִים֙ שָׂרֵ֣י מֵא֔וֹת שָׂרֵ֥י חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים וְשָׂרֵ֥י עֲשָׂרֹֽת׃

passages.text: Have these men judge the people at all times. Then they can bring you any major issue, but all minor cases they can judge on their own, so that your load may be lightened as they share it with you.
passages.sermon:
Appoint capable men as judges over the people.
These men will judge the people at all times.
If there is a major issue, they will bring it to you.
If there is a minor case, they will judge it themselves.
This will make your work easier.
They will help you carry the burden.
passages.original: וְשָׁפְט֣וּ אֶת־ הָעָם֮ בְּכָל־ עֵת֒ וְהָיָ֞ה כָּל־ הַדָּבָ֤ר הַגָּדֹל֙ יָבִ֣יאוּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְכָל־ הַדָּבָ֥ר הַקָּטֹ֖ן יִשְׁפְּטוּ־ הֵ֑ם וְהָקֵל֙ מֵֽעָלֶ֔יךָ וְנָשְׂא֖וּ אִתָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: If you follow this advice and God so directs you, then you will be able to endure, and all these people can go home in peace.”
passages.sermon:
Moses led the people of Israel.
Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, gave Moses advice.
Jethro told Moses to appoint capable, God-fearing, trustworthy men as leaders.
Jethro said, “If you do this thing, and if God commands you, you will be able to stand.”
You will endure the work.
All these people will return to their homes in peace.
passages.original: אִ֣ם אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֤ר הַזֶּה֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה וְצִוְּךָ֣ אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְיָֽכָלְתָּ֖ עֲמֹ֑ד וְגַם֙ כָּל־ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה עַל־ מְקֹמ֖וֹ יָבֹ֥א בְשָׁלֽוֹם׃

passages.text: Moses listened to his father-in-law and did everything he said.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Jethro was Moses’ father-in-law.
Jethro gave Moses advice.
Moses listened to Jethro’s advice.
Moses did everything Jethro told him.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע מֹשֶׁ֖ה לְק֣וֹל חֹתְנ֑וֹ וַיַּ֕עַשׂ כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָמָֽר׃

passages.text: So Moses chose capable men from all Israel and made them heads over the people as leaders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens.
passages.sermon:
Moses led the people of Israel.
Moses needed help to judge and lead the people.
Moses chose capable men from all the Israelites.
Moses appointed these men as leaders over the people.
Some men became leaders over thousands.
Some men became leaders over hundreds.
Some men became leaders over fifties.
Some men became leaders over tens.
passages.original: וַיִּבְחַ֨ר מֹשֶׁ֤ה אַנְשֵׁי־ חַ֙יִל֙ מִכָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֛ם רָאשִׁ֖ים עַל־ הָעָ֑ם שָׂרֵ֤י אֲלָפִים֙ שָׂרֵ֣י מֵא֔וֹת שָׂרֵ֥י חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים וְשָׂרֵ֥י עֲשָׂרֹֽת׃

passages.text: And they judged the people at all times; they would bring the difficult cases to Moses, but any minor issue they would judge themselves.
passages.sermon:
Moses appointed leaders over the people of Israel.
These leaders judged the people at all times.
They brought every difficult case to Moses.
They judged every minor issue themselves.
passages.original: וְשָׁפְט֥וּ אֶת־ הָעָ֖ם בְּכָל־ עֵ֑ת אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֤ר הַקָּשֶׁה֙ יְבִיא֣וּן אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְכָל־ הַדָּבָ֥ר הַקָּטֹ֖ן יִשְׁפּוּט֥וּ הֵֽם׃

passages.text: Then Moses sent his father-in-law on his way, and Jethro returned to his own land.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Jethro was Moses’ father-in-law.
Moses sent his father-in-law away.
Jethro returned to his own land.
passages.original: וַיְשַׁלַּ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶת־ חֹתְנ֑וֹ וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ ל֖וֹ אֶל־ אַרְצֽוֹ׃פ
